description: 🚨 Spot the Spike. Track the Trend. Whether it's a midnight mishap or a midday malfunction, instantly identify patterns in incident timing and severity with intuitive, time-based visualisation. 🕒 Why the Safety Clock? Temporal Precision: Visualise incidents across a 24-hour cycle to uncover hidden rhythms. Severity at a Glance: See not just when incidents happen, but how serious they are. Actionable Intelligence: Drive smarter decisions with real-time awareness and trend clarity.
